newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Endesa, Portugal EDP to swap stakes - paper.
newsitem.headline: Endesa, Portugal EDP to swap stakes - paper.

text.p: Portuguese electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal and Spain's Endesa are preparing to make a strategic alliance which would involve the exchange of small stakes in each other's share capital, the Portuguese daily "Diario Economico" said on Wednesday.
The paper said the two companies would swap stakes of between one and two percent next year.

It said Endesa officials were in Lisbon this week to discuss the deal which it said would take place before Endesa's privatisation, scheduled for September, and the privatisation of EDP which is due in the first half of next year.
EDP officials were unavailable to comment on the report.
